description: Hundreds of pro-Palestinian demonstrators gathered at the Port of Tacoma, Washington, to block a US military supply ship, MV Cape Orlando, suspected to be carrying weapons and military equipment bound for Israel. The activists, organized by the Arab Resource & Organizing Center (AROC), aimed to prevent the cargo from being loaded, demanding an immediate cease-fire and an end to US military aid to Israel amid the ongoing Israel-Hamas conflict.

mainImage.alt: Pro-Palestinian demonstrators swarm the Port of Tacoma, to protest a Middle East-bound ship full of what they believe to be military equipment and weapons. Nov. 6, 2023

title: Pro-Palestinian Activists Block US Military Supply Shipment to Israel in Port Protest
